limitations: Original run.json, archived INI files and native-preflight proof were not supplied. Reconstructed declarations check compatibility, not original run provenance.
Recorded starts, identities, opening prefixes, search settings and outcomes match the declarations. Engine names and profile hashes do not attest the executable or native material tables.
Moves and terminal outcomes were not independently replayed. No games, engine searches, material fit, Elo or population confidence interval were produced.

overall.method: Equal opponent means over shared fully completed opening cases; every configured repetition requires a complete color pair. Draws count half a point.

provenance.policy: Current-design automatic raw MG/EG values, applied consistently to all six engine tables for every sibling. Shared diagonal grants use F as their common anchor. Existing references remain fixed. No values are fitted from game outcomes.
provenance.diagnostic: levelupvalues version 1; no searches or match games

reviewRules.meaning: Descriptive triage only. A review priority requires both complete fixed halves outside the target in the same direction and at least two opponent scores beyond that boundary in both halves. No statistical acceptance or early stopping is implied.

notes: Reduced/current/expanded describe movement choices; measured strength need not follow that order at a fixed search budget.
Each cohort uses only opening cases with complete color pairs against every included opponent. Opponents and shared cases receive equal weight.
The first and second fixed halves are predeclared opening lists, not the first games or cases to finish. A cohort is complete only when every row has all its scheduled shared cases.
Rows retain their own purchase budgets. Single-queen acceptance and two-upgrade acceptance are not pooled into a global score.

Material tables are internal engine units, not measured pawn values, purchase prices or Elo. The automatic column shows the raw table; the audit JSON also retains automatic capture/evaluation tables. Applied values are common within each bracket, and native preflight checks them across all six tables for both colors.
The tables are conditional on these openings, placements, evaluation policy and search budget. Target and matchup flags guide further review; they do not prove balance or a confidence interval.
